description: This file contains a class implementing Drupal form hooks for content translation, including form alterations for content entity forms and field configuration forms, managing multilingual settings and translation synchronization.

classes.name: ContentTranslationFormHooks
classes.description: Implements Drupal form hooks for content translation, handling form alterations for content entity forms and field configuration forms, managing multilingual settings and translation synchronization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for entity type management, user session, content translation management, redirect destination, and field sync widget.

methods.name: formAlter
methods.description: Alters content entity forms to add multilingual translation options and handle translation-related form modifications.

methods.name: formFieldConfigEditFormAlter
methods.description: Alters field configuration forms to add translatability options and translation synchronization settings.
